titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 81: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 81. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number [ⲡⲁ] (top right, odd page) printed wholly inside restoration brackets, with a bar above and below as the frame (no strokes; 43). Running title [ⲙⲡⲥⲁϩ] in brackets, no ornaments. Every dot run was counted from the `dots` x-positions (runs of 10 or more from the positions only). Every ϣ on the page (ll. 20, 25, 27, 32) is undotted (8×).
